verses.original: וְאַתָּה֙ שָׂ֣א קִינָ֔ה אֶל־ נְשִׂיאֵ֖י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.literal: As for you take up a lament for the princes of Israel

verses.original: וְאָמַרְתָּ֗ מָ֤ה אִמְּךָ֙ לְבִיָּ֔א בֵּ֥ין אֲרָי֖וֹת רָבָ֑צָה בְּת֥וֹךְ כְּפִרִ֖ים רִבְּתָ֥ה גוּרֶֽיהָ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’ā·mar·tā māh ’im·mə·ḵā lə·ḇî·yā bên ’ă·rā·yō·wṯ rā·ḇā·ṣāh bə·ṯō·wḵ kə·p̄i·rîm rib·bə·ṯāh ḡū·re·hā
verses.literal: and say What was your mother A lioness among the lions She lay down among the young lions she reared her cubs

verses.original: וַתַּ֛עַל אֶחָ֥ד מִגֻּרֶ֖יהָ הָיָ֑ה כְּפִ֣יר וַיִּלְמַ֥ד לִטְרָף־ טֶ֖רֶף אָכָֽל׃ אָדָ֥ם
verses.transliteration: wat·ta·‘al ’e·ḥāḏ mig·gu·re·hā hā·yāh kə·p̄îr way·yil·maḏ liṭ·rāp̄- ṭe·rep̄ ’ā·ḵāl ’ā·ḏām
verses.literal: She brought up one of her cubs and he became a young lion After learning to tear [his] prey he devoured men

verses.original: גּוֹיִ֖ם וַיִּשְׁמְע֥וּ אֵלָ֛יו נִתְפָּ֑שׂ בְּשַׁחְתָּ֣ם בַֽחַחִ֖ים וַיְבִאֻ֥הוּ אֶל־ אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: gō·w·yim way·yiš·mə·‘ū ’ê·lāw niṯ·pāś bə·šaḥ·tām ḇa·ḥa·ḥîm way·ḇi·’u·hū ’el- ’e·reṣ miṣ·rā·yim
verses.literal: When the nations heard of him he was trapped in their pit With hooks they led him away to the land of Egypt

verses.original: וַתֵּ֙רֶא֙ כִּ֣י נֽוֹחֲלָ֔ה תִּקְוָתָ֑הּ אָבְדָ֖ה וַתִּקַּ֛ח אֶחָ֥ד מִגֻּרֶ֖יהָ שָׂמָֽתְהוּ׃ כְּפִ֥יר
verses.transliteration: wat·tê·re kî nō·w·ḥă·lāh tiq·wā·ṯāh ’ā·ḇə·ḏāh wat·tiq·qaḥ ’e·ḥāḏ mig·gu·re·hā śā·mā·ṯə·hū kə·p̄îr
verses.literal: When she saw that she had waited in vain that her hope was lost she took another of her cubs and made him a young lion

verses.original: וַיִּתְהַלֵּ֥ךְ בְּתוֹךְ־ אֲרָי֖וֹת הָיָ֑ה כְּפִ֣יר וַיִּלְמַ֥ד לִטְרָף־ טֶ֖רֶף אָכָֽל׃ אָדָ֥ם
verses.transliteration: way·yiṯ·hal·lêḵ bə·ṯō·wḵ- ’ă·rā·yō·wṯ hā·yāh kə·p̄îr way·yil·maḏ liṭ·rāp̄- ṭe·rep̄ ’ā·ḵāl ’ā·ḏām
verses.literal: He prowled among the lions and became a young lion After learning to tear [his] prey he devoured men

verses.original: וַיֵּ֙דַע֙ אַלְמְנוֹתָ֔יו הֶחֱרִ֑יב וְעָרֵיהֶ֖ם אֶ֙רֶץ֙ וּמְלֹאָ֔הּ וַתֵּ֤שַׁם מִקּ֖וֹל שַׁאֲגָתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·ḏa‘ ’al·mə·nō·w·ṯāw he·ḥĕ·rîḇ wə·‘ā·rê·hem ’e·reṣ ū·mə·lō·’āh wat·tê·šam miq·qō·wl ša·’ă·ḡā·ṯōw
verses.literal: He broke down their strongholds and devastated their cities The land and everything in it shuddered at the sound of his roaring

verses.original: גּוֹיִ֛ם וַיִּתְּנ֨וּ עָלָ֥יו מִמְּדִינ֑וֹת סָבִ֖יב וַֽיִּפְרְשׂ֥וּ רִשְׁתָּ֖ם עָלָ֛יו נִתְפָּֽשׂ׃ בְּשַׁחְתָּ֥ם
verses.transliteration: gō·w·yim way·yit·tə·nū ‘ā·lāw mim·mə·ḏî·nō·wṯ sā·ḇîḇ way·yip̄·rə·śū riš·tām ‘ā·lāw niṯ·pāś bə·šaḥ·tām
verses.literal: Then the nations set out against him from the provinces on every side They spread their net over him he was trapped in their pit

verses.original: בַּֽחַחִ֔ים וַֽיִּתְּנֻ֤הוּ בַסּוּגַר֙ וַיְבִאֻ֖הוּ אֶל־ מֶ֣לֶךְ בָּבֶ֑ל יְבִאֻ֙הוּ֙ בַּמְּצֹד֔וֹת לְמַ֗עַן קוֹל֛וֹ יִשָּׁמַ֥ע לֹא־ ע֖וֹד אֶל־ הָרֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃פ
verses.transliteration: ba·ḥa·ḥîm way·yit·tə·nu·hū ḇas·sū·ḡar way·ḇi·’u·hū ’el- me·leḵ bā·ḇel yə·ḇi·’u·hū bam·mə·ṣō·ḏō·wṯ lə·ma·‘an qō·w·lōw yiš·šā·ma‘ lō- ‘ō·wḏ ’el- hā·rê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: With hooks they caged him . . . and brought him to the king of Babylon They brought him into captivity so that his roar was heard no longer on the mountains of Israel

verses.original: אִמְּךָ֥ כַגֶּ֛פֶן בְּדָמְךָ֖ שְׁתוּלָ֑ה עַל־ מַ֣יִם הָיְתָ֖ה פֹּֽרִיָּה֙ וַֽעֲנֵפָ֔ה רַבִּֽים׃ מִמַּ֥יִם
verses.transliteration: ’im·mə·ḵā ḵag·ge·p̄en bə·ḏā·mə·ḵā šə·ṯū·lāh ‘al- ma·yim hā·yə·ṯāh pō·rî·yāh wa·‘ă·nê·p̄āh rab·bîm mim·ma·yim
verses.literal: Your mother was like a vine in your vineyard planted by the water it was fruitful and full of branches because of the abundant waters

verses.original: וַיִּֽהְיוּ־ לָ֞הּ עֹ֗ז מַטּ֣וֹת אֶל־ מֹֽשְׁלִ֔ים שִׁבְטֵי֙ וַתִּגְבַּ֥הּ קֽוֹמָת֖וֹ עַל־ בֵּ֣ין עֲבֹתִ֑ים וַיֵּרָ֣א בְגָבְה֔וֹ בְּרֹ֖ב דָּלִיֹּתָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: way·yih·yū- lāh ‘ōz maṭ·ṭō·wṯ ’el- mō·šə·lîm šiḇ·ṭê wat·tiḡ·bah qō·w·mā·ṯōw ‘al- bên ‘ă·ḇō·ṯîm way·yê·rā ḇə·ḡā·ḇə·hōw bə·rōḇ dā·lî·yō·ṯāw
verses.literal: It had strong branches fit for a ruler’s scepter It towered high above . . . the thick branches conspicuous for its height and for its dense foliage

verses.original: וַתֻּתַּ֤שׁ בְּחֵמָה֙ הֻשְׁלָ֔כָה לָאָ֣רֶץ הַקָּדִ֖ים וְר֥וּחַ הוֹבִ֣ישׁ פִּרְיָ֑הּ עֻזָּ֖הּ מַטֵּ֥ה הִתְפָּרְק֧וּ וְיָבֵ֛שׁוּ אֵ֥שׁ אֲכָלָֽתְהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tut·taš bə·ḥê·māh huš·lā·ḵāh lā·’ā·reṣ haq·qā·ḏîm wə·rū·aḥ hō·w·ḇîš pir·yāh ‘uz·zāh maṭ·ṭêh hiṯ·pā·rə·qū wə·yā·ḇê·šū ’êš ’ă·ḵā·lā·ṯə·hū
verses.literal: But it was uprooted in fury cast down to the ground and the east wind dried up its fruit Its strong branches were stripped off and they withered the fire consumed them

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֖ה שְׁתוּלָ֣ה בַמִּדְבָּ֑ר צִיָּ֥ה וְצָמָֽא׃ בְּאֶ֖רֶץ
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh šə·ṯū·lāh ḇam·miḏ·bār ṣî·yāh wə·ṣā·mā bə·’e·reṣ
verses.literal: Now it is planted in the wilderness in a dry and thirsty land

verses.original: אֵ֜שׁ וַתֵּצֵ֨א מִמַּטֵּ֤ה בַדֶּ֙יהָ֙ אָכָ֔לָה פִּרְיָ֣הּ בָ֛הּ וְלֹא־ עֹ֖ז מַטֵּה־ הָ֥יָה לִמְשׁ֑וֹל שֵׁ֣בֶט הִ֖יא קִ֥ינָה וַתְּהִ֥י לְקִינָֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: ’êš wat·tê·ṣê mim·maṭ·ṭêh ḇad·de·hā ’ā·ḵā·lāh pir·yāh ḇāh wə·lō- ‘ōz maṭ·ṭêh- hā·yāh lim·šō·wl šê·ḇeṭ hî qî·nāh wat·tə·hî lə·qî·nāh
verses.literal: Fire has gone out from its main branch . . . and devoured its fruit on it no strong branch remains fit for a ruler’s scepter This is a lament and shall be used as a lament
